lyrics: charaNam 2,3,4,5 to be played similar to charaNam 1
charaNam 2 - ninDAra rAjU nidrincu nidrayu okaTE anDanE baNTu nidra adiyu okaTE
meNDaina brahmANuDu meTTu bhUmi okaTE chaNDAlundEti sari bhUmi okaTE

dIna mahOrAtramulu tegi dhanAdyuna-kokaTE vonara nirupEdakunu okaTE aviyu
charaNam 4 - koralu shishTannamulu gonu nAkkalokaTE tirugu dushTAnnamulu dinu nAkkalokaTE
paragu durgandhamulapai vAyuvokaTE varusha parimaLamupai vAyuvokaTE

kaDu puNyalanu pApa karmulanu sarigAva jaDiyu shrI venkaTEshvaru nAma-mokaTE
